features: AHD, TVI and CVI inputs up to 8MP; CVBS PAL/NTSC
Can be used as an encoder to connect analog cameras to the EasyView VMS
notes: Datasheet states power consumption as max 15 W without HDD.
Datasheet gives 16 IP inputs, each up to 1080P, with a total of max 32 channels; product sheet gives 16+8 IP inputs, each up to 5MP, and 24 video input channels. IP channel count and total left out.

Datasheet states max 8MP per IP channel in its feature list and 1080P per IP channel in its table; product sheet states 5MP per IP channel and up to 4K-N/5MP for recording. Maximum camera resolution left out.
Datasheet gives audio in/out 4/1; product sheet gives 6/1. Audio counts left out.
Datasheet gives 2 x HDMI + 1 x VGA; product sheet gives 1 x HDMI, VGA and CVBS output. Video outputs left out.
Datasheet gives 10/100M Ethernet; product sheet gives 10/100/1000. Ethernet speed left out.
Datasheet gives 100 to 240 VAC; product sheet gives 230 V. Power supply left out.
Datasheet gives net weight 4.65 kg without HDD; product sheet gives 1.8 kg. Weight left out.
